Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.math

Class MatrixObject

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.SceneObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.math.MatrixObject
public final class MatrixObject extends SceneObject
Rectangular immutable labels with independently timed highlights and cell visibility. All times are scene-local seconds.

Copies rectangular cell labels and stores visibility changes in per-cell ordered maps. Row/column/cell highlights use half-open time intervals; the last configured overlapping highlight wins. All indices are zero-based and independent of render order.
